rationale: Both independently catch the same major, well-grounded bug (ARDiffusionModelRunner.execute_model not accepting diffusion_kv_metadata, causing a TypeError swallowed into a user-facing error) with near-identical evidence quality. X uniquely matches the ground-truth P2 concern that request-mode validates envelopes while execute_batch/execute_step paths skip that check. Y uniquely and substantively echoes asukaqaq-s's core validation-ownership critique by flagging that the new DTOs (metadata.py) carry none of the local construction-time invariants (unique IDs, referential integrity) that the sibling #5541 DTOs enforce — nearly restating asukaqaq-s's own three-tier validation taxonomy — and also catches the duplicate-validation-with-different-messages issue and a subtle ownership bug in the new close()-on-caller-owned-scheduler cleanup path. Most ground-truth inline comments reference stage_kv/interface.py code that no longer exists in this diff (superseded by diffusion_kv/metadata.py), capping achievable recall for both. Both are well cited with file:line and quoted code; Y's tiered Required/Should-fix/Minor structure with concrete suggested patches (e.g. the __post_init__ snippet) is marginally more actionable than X's flatter severity-tagged list.
